G1.evidence: Massachusetts does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts on the discipline of attorneys, on the recommendation of the Board of Bar Overseers, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 168 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Judicial Court of Massachusetts on the discipline of attorneys, on the recommendation of the Board of Bar Overseers, 1975 to 2025. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 2 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Massachusetts publishes no business register we can query. The Secretary of the Commonwealth's corporate search answers a request for its robots file with a 403 and its search page with a redirect loop, and the state runs no open data portal carrying the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 4 named attorneys published.

G6.evidence: 336 public client reviews across 2 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 1999-03-11, so it has been operating for more than a year

json_ld_descriptions: Injuries extend beyond financial expenses to encompass disrupted daily life, strained relationships, sleep disturbances, and diminished confidence. When negligence by another person or entity causes these hardships, Colucci, Colucci & Marcus, P.C. works to hold them accountable. The firm prioritizes your health, time, and future by listening to your account, developing evidence, and pursuing your claim with consistent effort toward full compensation. Boston personal injury lawyers at the firm can be reached at (617) 698-6000 to discuss what occurred, establish your path forward, and pursue recovery within the scope of applicable law.
